title: One of a kind parks
text: One of a kind parks!  Great walking tour .  Beautiful architecture & art .. be prepared for steps.  Our audio didn’t work on our phones!
author: Nancy_T

title: It did not disappoint!  Amazing!!
text: Park Guell is the reason my husband and I wanted to bring our adult children with us on this trip. It did not disappoint. Our children loved it as much as we did.
author: Sheila_Z

title: Not what I expected but a must see in Barcelona
text: Beautiful scenery and views of Barcelona but be sure you have your tickets in an accessible without WiFi way in advance. It’s a lovely walk in the park with some amazing tile work.
author: Jennie_B
